name: foray-mobile
description: The native app shell (issue #36). Deliberately NOT at the repo root: the root is dependency-free with no build step, which is what lets the keyless GitHub Action deploy the static site from main's root — see the root package.json's own description and CLAUDE.md. Capacitor's node_modules and its build step live here and reach UP into the repo for the web files, so the web deploy path is untouched. Same pattern as tools/corpus/ and backend/.
//no-test-script: Intentional. tools/ci/run-suites.mjs scans player/, test/ and tools/ only, so no suite is ever discovered under mobile/ and this package is never installed by CI. The shell's own suites live in tools/mobile/ (dependency-free, root group). If SCANNED_DIRS is ever widened to include mobile/, the runner will hard-error on 'dependencies but no test script' — that is the loud failure it is designed to give, and the fix is to add a test script here, not to widen the scan quietly.
//webdir: www/ is a BUILD ARTEFACT, gitignored, rebuilt by ../tools/mobile/prepare-webdir.mjs. Never edit anything inside it; you would be editing a copy of the real site.

scripts.add:ios: npm run prepare:webdir && cap add ios
scripts.add:android: npm run prepare:webdir && cap add android
